slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: a luxury Greek venue ceremony set up and ready, signalling what a package actually delivers on the day.
slots.shot_brief: Official image from one venue whose package the guide describes (Elounda Beach or Elounda Peninsula in Crete, or Grace Hotel in Santorini): a ceremony set-up on a sea-view terrace or lawn, chairs and floral arch in place, Aegean water behind, May to October, golden-hour light. No people, or only distant unidentifiable figures; no signage. Landscape 3:2 with room for a title crop. Source: the venue's own media kit or press office with written permission (Gmail draft request, created by a human or a non-fast run, never sent by an agent), or licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to library-index.csv. Never AI, never a competitor, directory, planner, photographer-blog or search-result image. Location proven by the media kit, register row or EXIF, never by appearance. Use only a venue whose own package is described in the article, so the image never implies a package or partnership we do not describe.
